title: Managed services events
description: State and event log of every managed service in the resource group, across providers, as the marketplace records them: health, backups and utilization changes, reconciliation, backups, autoscaling.

list.name: provider
list.label: Provider
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) WHERE provider != '' ORDER BY provider

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) WHERE provider != '' ORDER BY provider

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.definition:
SELECT service, if(name != '', name, service) FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) WHERE provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) OR provider = '' ORDER BY name, service

list.name: event
list.label: Event
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Services

targets.rawSql:
SELECT info.service AS ServiceId, info.name AS ServiceName, info.provider AS Provider,
  health.state AS Health, health.message AS `Health message`, backups.state AS Backups, util.v AS `Utilization not normal`,
  errors.n AS `Error events`, errors.last AS `Last event`
FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS info
LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, argMax(multiIf(Body = 'Provider reports the service as healthy', 'healthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as degraded', 'degraded',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as unhealthy', 'unhealthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service health as unknown', 'unknown', ''), Timestamp) AS state,
    argMax(LogAttributes['message'], Timestamp) AS message, max(Timestamp) AS since
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND multiIf(Body = 'Provider reports the service as healthy', 'healthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as degraded', 'degraded',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as unhealthy', 'unhealthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service health as unknown', 'unknown', '') != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS health USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, argMax(multiIf(Body = 'Backups are up to date', 'upToDate', Body = 'Backups are overdue', 'overdue', ''), Timestamp) AS state,
    argMax(LogAttributes['message'], Timestamp) AS message, max(Timestamp) AS since
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND multiIf(Body = 'Backups are up to date', 'upToDate', Body = 'Backups are overdue', 'overdue', '') != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS backups USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, arrayStringConcat(groupArray(concat(resource, ': ', state, if(message != '', concat(' (', message, ')'), ''))), ', ') AS v
  FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, extract(Body, '^Utilization of (.+) is (?:normal|close to the plan value|at the plan value)$') AS resource, argMax(multiIf(endsWith(Body, ' is normal'), 'normal', endsWith(Body, ' is close to the plan value'), 'closeToLimit', endsWith(Body, ' is at the plan value'), 'atLimit', ''), Timestamp) AS state,
    argMax(LogAttributes['message'], Timestamp) AS message, max(Timestamp) AS since
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND multiIf(endsWith(Body, ' is normal'), 'normal', endsWith(Body, ' is close to the plan value'), 'closeToLimit', endsWith(Body, ' is at the plan value'), 'atLimit', '') != ''
  GROUP BY service, extract(Body, '^Utilization of (.+) is (?:normal|close to the plan value|at the plan value)$') AS resource) WHERE state != 'normal' GROUP BY service) AS util USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, countIf(SeverityNumber >= 17) AS n, max(Timestamp) AS last
  FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' GROUP BY service) AS errors USING service
WHERE info.service IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY Health = 'unhealthy' DESC, Health = 'degraded' DESC, `Error events` DESC, ServiceName
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.description: Health and backups are the latest state the provider reported, which the marketplace logs when it changes; empty when it hasn't changed in the last 7 days. Error events count the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') AS level, count() AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) IN (${event:singlequote}) AND multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') IN (${severity:singlequote})
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
GROUP BY time, level ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, if(info.provider = '', 'unknown', info.provider) AS provider, count() AS value
FROM otel_logs AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS info ON info.service = l.LogAttributes['targetId']
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) IN (${event:singlequote}) AND multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') IN (${severity:singlequote})
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search) AND SeverityNumber >= 17
GROUP BY time, provider ORDER BY time

SELECT if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) AS Event, countIf(SeverityNumber >= 17) AS Errors, countIf(SeverityNumber >= 13 AND SeverityNumber < 17) AS Warnings,
  count() AS Total, uniqExact(LogAttributes['targetId']) AS Services, max(Timestamp) AS Last
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) IN (${event:singlequote}) AND multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') IN (${severity:singlequote})
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
GROUP BY Event ORDER BY Errors DESC, Total DESC

panels.title: Event log

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.Timestamp AS Time, multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') AS Severity, info.provider AS Provider, info.name AS ServiceName, LogAttributes['targetId'] AS ServiceId,
  if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) AS Event, Body AS Message,
  arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', [
    if(LogAttributes['message'] != '', concat('message: ', LogAttributes['message']), ''),
    if(LogAttributes['previousStatus'] != '', concat('was: ', LogAttributes['previousStatus']), ''),
    if(LogAttributes['error'] != '', concat('error: ', LogAttributes['error']), '')]), '; ') AS Details,
  LogAttributes['creator'] AS Creator
FROM otel_logs AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS info ON info.service = l.LogAttributes['targetId']
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
  AND if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) IN (${event:singlequote}) AND multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') IN (${severity:singlequote})
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
ORDER BY l.Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.description: Newest first. Details holds the attributes some events add: the provider's message, the previous state, the error.

panels.title: Utilization of plan

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time,
  concat(if(Attributes['name'] != '', Attributes['name'], Attributes['targetId']), ' ', Attributes['resource']) AS resource, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND Attributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote}) AND MetricName = 'codesphere.managed_service.utilization.ratio'
GROUP BY time, resource ORDER BY time

panels.description: Value divided by the plan value, per resource, as the marketplace exports it (codesphere.managed_service.utilization).
